# D-11's CJK gate allowlist — read by .github/scripts/check-cjk-scope.sh.
#
# Format: one entry per non-comment, non-blank line, `<path-glob>:<extended-regex>`, split on the
# FIRST colon. The path glob is matched against the file path (a `case` pattern — `*` crosses
# directory separators). The regex is matched against the line's text with `grep -E`.
#
# An entry exempts a LINE, not a file. A path glob that matches a whole file does NOT exempt that
# file's other lines — only lines whose text also matches the paired regex are skipped. There is
# no mechanism here for a blanket per-file or per-directory exemption, by construction.
#
# Adding a fourth entry is a reviewable one-line diff. That is deliberate: a growing allowlist is
# itself the signal D-11 wants to keep visible. Do not fold new exemptions into an existing entry's
# regex to avoid a visible line-count change in review.
#
# Exactly three entries are authorised by D-11 (see 08-CONTEXT.md):
#
#   1. The i18n("...") call-site literals in src/main/java. These are functionally lang/*.json
#      keys — changing one breaks the message lookup (D-08). (The lang/*.json catalogue files
#      themselves are excluded from the gate's scan scope entirely, not via this allowlist — see
#      check-cjk-scope.sh's own header for that structural exclusion and why.)
#
#   2. The four bilingual config.yml comment constants in UltiTools.java (COMMAND_BLOCKLIST_COMMENT,
#      EDITABLE_ROOTS_COMMENT, ACTION_LOG_SIZE_COMMENT, ACTION_LOG_FILES_COMMENT). These are
#      operator-facing text that is already English-first with a Chinese line beneath it, and stays
#      as it is (D-08). The regex below matches only those four lines' distinctive opening phrases,
#      not a bare filename — UltiTools.java's other ~50 CJK lines (javadoc, inline comments) still
#      fail the gate.
#
#   3. README.md's language-label link(s) — a Markdown/HTML anchor whose visible label names the
#      target language (e.g. the "中文文档" link next to "English"). Per the root monorepo
#      CLAUDE.md's publication-language policy, links whose label names the target language are a
#      standing exemption category. README.md is not itself inside check-cjk-scope.sh's default
#      scan scope (src/main, .github/workflows, buildtools) as of this plan — this entry documents
#      the exemption for completeness and for any future scope widening that includes it.
#
# src/test proper is out of scope entirely (D-08) and needs no entries here. pom.xml and
# SECURITY.md are likewise outside the covered scope and need no entries.

src/main/java/*:i18n\(\s*"
src/main/java/com/ultikits/ultitools/UltiTools.java:^\s*"(面板永远不允许远程执行的命令列表|面板文件 API 可以在其中读取|action\.log\.0（当前活跃文件）|保留的 action\.log\.<代数>)
README.md:<a href="[^"]*">[^<]*</a>
